intro: Ragefire Chasm is a network of volcanic caverns situated directly beneath the Horde capital of Orgrimmar. Accessible through the Cleft of Shadow, its magma-lit tunnels harbor feral troggs and a hidden sect of the Shadow Council bent on unraveling the young orcish nation from within.

p: While Thrall works to secure Durotar above, subterranean dangers fester directly beneath Orgrimmar's foundation. Ragefire Chasm is an unstable network of volcanic vents and magma rivers that has become infested with savage Ragefire troggs. Rising from unknown depths below the tunnels, these hostile creatures violently rebuffed diplomatic overtures made by Magatha Grimtotem. Left unchecked, their sheer numbers threaten to undermine and overrun the capital.
